data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 7.2m (2018: GBP 68.9m) is an improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.event_name: Favourable development on Professional Indemnity and Property Binders / favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes
prior_year_events.impact_description: Described as an improvement to claims reserves established at the prior year end driven by favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes, partially offset by unfavourable developments in other classes.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 was GBP 322.0m. Analysis of claims development shows a gross adverse re-estimation on the 2017 underwriting year of about GBP 7.8m (strengthening), although the report notes a net improvement of GBP 1.0m included within net claims incurred owing to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine and offsets from other classes. Overall the prior year movement on a gross basis is an adverse movement concentrated in the 2017 year of account, while net development (after reinsurance) was modestly favourable.
raw_causal_phrases: Actual vs expected claims development was favourable in the period driven by the Professional Indemnity and Property Binders classes.
favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.
data.data_quality_notes: Primary opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (liabilities: Claims outstanding). No explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was provided; prior-year gross movement is calculated from the gross claims development table available only for the 2017 underwriting year (increase of GBP 7.824k). The narrative reports a net improvement of GBP 1.0m (net of reinsurance), indicating reinsurance recoveries offset the gross adverse movement. RITC adjustments (2016 & prior in 2018) and other reinsurance transactions may distort comparisons; only the 2017 gross triangle was available for calculation.
